subject: Request: temporary backup quarantine & deletion-offset for GeoSync pilot
messages:
From: Anika Patel <anika.patel@geosync.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Temporary backup quarantine request for GeoSync pilot

Hi Vanessa / Redwood team,

Thanks again for getting the GeoSync integration into a pilot window. During our initial data run we discovered that a subset of customer records used in the pilot are subject to an inbound regulatory hold at the customer's request. We need a temporary quarantine that will delay any automated backup purges and offsite snapshot deletions for the pilot dataset while we complete consent reconciliation.

Requested details: 1) 21-day deletion-offset on all backups that contain pilot_bucket_2027-01; 2) an evidence package from Redwood confirming snapshots are retained and not removed during the window; 3) a DPA addendum or short rider that notes the quarantine timeline and scope.

Attached is a high-level data map for the pilot and the formal quarantine request we submit to procurement/legal.

Requested by: GeoSync privacy team. Proposed window: Jan 15 — Feb 05, 2027 (flexible).

Can Redwood confirm owners for: infra change, retention policy update, and evidence delivery? We will need a signed acknowledgement (DocuSign acceptable) to proceed.

Thanks,
Anika Patel
Data Privacy Lead | GeoSync
[Attachment: pilot_MVP_data_map.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: geosync_quarantine_request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Anika Patel <anika.patel@geosync.io>, GeoSync Ops <ops@geosync.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 18:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Temporary backup quarantine request for GeoSync pilot

Thanks Anika — sensible ask for a pilot. Internal owners below:
- Infra (snapshot & retention changes): Karthik Iyer
- Ops (monitoring & audit): Ben Carter
- Security & evidence: Marissa Cole
- Legal/contract: Kimberly Park

Quick clarifying Qs before we mobilize:
1) Do you need us to stop automatic snapshot pruning only, or to also halt cross-region archival lifecycles?
2) Can you confirm the exact list of buckets / prefixes (you mentioned pilot_bucket_2027-01) and a sample object manifest?

We can provision a 21-day offset as proposed; Karthik will scope infra impact and provide a rollback plan. Kimberly — can legal advise if a DPA addendum or a short rider is the preferred instrument here?

I will assemble the canary plan and timeline and send back by EOD tomorrow (Jan 13).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_evidence_digest.txt (txt)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Temporary backup quarantine request for GeoSync pilot

Vanessa — I scoped the infra implications this morning. Summary and proposed controls: 

Impact summary:
- Delaying automated purge for 21 days on a named prefix will increase snapshot retention counts and S3-like storage costs on the affected clusters.
- Cross-region archival lifecycles (tiering to cold storage) will need an explicit override if GeoSync expects no archival movement during the window.
- Continuous-batch backup jobs rely on TTL metadata — we can add a quarantine flag to an object prefix to exclude it from deletion sweeps.

Proposed technical plan:
1) Implement a quarantine tag on pilot_bucket_2027-01 across EU clusters (cluster-eu-1, cluster-eu-2).
2) Adjust purge worker to check quarantine flag for 21 days — default expiry timestamp: 2027-02-05T00:00:00Z.
3) Emit an immutable evidence artifact to our evidence S3 bucket with a signed manifest and retention metadata (will provide a signed digest).
4) Add monitoring alert + manual rollback playbook (rollback to standard purge after confirmation).

Risks / notes:
- Cost delta estimate: ~+0.8% monthly storage for cluster-eu-1 during this window (rough).
- If we are asked to halt cross-region archival, that will require coordination with marketplace/partner export and may impact transfer billing.

I will prepare the change ticket and a canary plan for Jan 15 that runs the quarantine on a single shard. Ben — can you confirm ops readiness for the evidence snapshot?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 11:36:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Temporary backup quarantine request for GeoSync pilot

Vanessa / team — legal is aligned with a short DPA addendum that narrowly scopes the quarantine to the pilot prefixes and dates. Requirements from legal: 
1) Formal written request from GeoSync on company letterhead (attaching geosync_quarantine_request.pdf) — we can accept DocuSign.
2) Evidence package: signed manifest + retention metadata + audit logs demonstrating snapshot retention; evidence must be delivered within 48 hours of the quarantine start.
3) Explicit acceptance of cost uplift and a statement that GeoSync will cover incremental storage costs for the window (or confirm Redwood covers — please advise).

I attached a template quarantine rider for GeoSync to sign and a checklist for the evidence artifacts we need. Once signed we will push the DPA addendum as an annex and route for approvals.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: geosync_quarantine_request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Anika Patel <anika.patel@geosync.io>, GeoSync Ops <ops@geosync.io>, Liam O'Reilly <liam@partnerproc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 23:14:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Temporary backup quarantine request for GeoSync pilot — Redwood plan & next steps

Anika / GeoSync team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Below is the Redwood plan and required hooks to proceed. Please consider this a one-email mutual action plan.

Plan (canary + scale):
- Jan 15 20:00 UTC — Canary: apply quarantine tag to pilot_bucket_2027-01 shard-01 on cluster-eu-1. Evidence manifest to be published to evidence-redwood/prod/geosync/pilot/2027-01-15-manifest.json within 2 hours.
- Jan 17 03:00 UTC — Review canary evidence & sign-off. If approved, extend quarantine to remaining shards and freeze purge workers for the prefix to 2027-02-05T00:00:00Z.
- Evidence delivered will include: signed manifest (sha256 digest), snapshot list, retention metadata, and audit log extract. Full checklist here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SERV-4872

Requests from GeoSync to sign:
1) Please sign the attached quarantine rider (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sign/placeholder) — we need this to be returned prior to canary.
2) Confirm who will accept incremental storage invoicing. Kimberly noted legal will require explicit coverage confirmation.

Attachments sent: geosync_quarantine_request.pdf; pilot_MVP_data_map.xlsx; redwood_evidence_digest.txt

If you approve, we will proceed with canary tonight and share the first evidence artifact within the 2-hour SLA. Reply with signed DocuSign or an explicit email acceptance.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
